hidden: Sensitive data is hidden. Reveal it before reviewing records or approving accounting actions.
error: Could not load or complete this operation. Refresh and review the current state before retrying.
ready: This step is ready for your review.
blocked: This step cannot proceed until its blockers are resolved.
partial: Preparation can process the ready subset; remaining exceptions stay in the task.
closeConsequence: Creates an immutable close snapshot and locks this fiscal period against normal posting. Corrections require an explicit, reasoned reopening. This does not certify external completeness or file a tax return.
taxConsequence: Finalizes the exact reviewed working-paper values below. This does not transmit or file a tax return.
exportConsequence: Prepares this artifact for plaintext export outside the encrypted book. The next save dialog is separate; cancelling it does not erase the prepared artifact and does not mean a file was saved.
unbalanced: Enter equal debit and credit totals; each line needs one side only.
